title: Gamble Drop
description: Gamble drops is a Datapack where ever block drop or mob drop is rolled by (0 to 4) and you either get nothing or more than usual drops
body:
# Gamble Drop 
## 🎲 Loot Multiplier (0x - 4x Drops)
**Tired of the same old predictable Minecraft drops? Welcome to the ultimate game of loot roulette. This datapack completely changes how resource gathering works by randomizing how many times a drop table is rolled every single time you break a block or defeat a mob.**

**Will you strike it rich, or will you break your diamond ore only to watch it vanish into thin air?**

## ⚙️ How It Works
**Every time a block is destroyed or a mob dies, the datapack triggers a random multiplier between 0 and 4. Instead of the standard drop, the game rerolls that entity's specific loot table based on your multiplier luck.**

**The 0x Roll (The Whammy): You get absolutely nothing. Zip. Nada.**

**The 1x Roll: Normal Minecraft behavior.**

**The 2x - 4x Rolls (The Jackpot): The loot table is rolled up to 4 separate times, stacking the rewards.**

## 💎 Features
- **Global Compatibility: Affects all blocks and all mobs, including modded ones if they use standard loot tables.**

- **High Risk, High Reward: Adds an exciting layer of gambling to everyday survival tasks. Mining for ancient debris just got a whole lot more stressful!**

- **Multiplayer Friendly: Works seamlessly on servers. Compete with your friends to see who has the best (or worst) RNG luck.**

- **Lightweight: Designed to run smoothly without causing server lag or TPS drops.**
